vault.note: Our best-selling hoodie, in the same black your team already wears in its polos. Warm enough for the shipping dock, light enough for the moulding floor, and it takes your logo cleanly in white.

tvest.note: Five-point tear-away: if a vest snags on a conveyor, robot cell or press guard it breaks away instead of pulling the wearer in. The right CSA spec for an automated plant like yours.

tee.note: CSA Class 1 cotton traffic tee for forklift aisles and material-handling routes. Cotton breathes on a warm injection-moulding floor through a full shift.

tt1.note: Moisture-wicking polyester version of the traffic tee, for the hottest press lines in summer. Same CSA visibility at the lowest price on this board.

tt4.note: Long-sleeve cotton traffic tee: arm coverage for people handling hot parts off the press or working around sharp trim, with no loss of visibility.

hoodie.note: Hi-vis traffic hoodie for the cooler months on receiving and shipping. Visible to forklift drivers, warm, and branded so contractors and visitors know who works here.

rk_sp24.note: Red Kap industrial short-sleeve work shirt: built for industrial laundering, a clean uniform look for team leads, setters and maintenance techs on the floor.

crewtee.note: Everyday cotton tee for non-hi-vis zones: assembly, QC and the toolroom. The lowest-cost way to put the Kumi name on everyone, which makes it a good first-day issue.

crewtee#w.note: Women's fit of the same everyday tee, so the welcome kit fits everyone you hire as the Bradford plant keeps growing.

tj2.note: CSA softshell traffic jacket for shipping, receiving and the yard: wind- and water-resistant for loading trucks bound for Honda Alliston.

freezer.note: Quilted hi-vis jacket for winter dock and yard work in Bradford. Insulated without bulk, so people can still drive a forklift and handle racks.

tp1.note: Winter traffic parka for anyone outside for long stretches in January: yard spotters, shippers, security. The warmest hi-vis piece on this board.

softshell.note: Balmy softshell, one of our top picks: what supervisors and engineers grab walking between the office and the floor. Black, to match your current polos.

softshell#w.note: Women's Balmy in the same black, so supervisors and engineers on the floor match as a team.

cs_h08000.note: Cuffed knit toque with an embroidered Kumi mark: cheap, worn all winter, and a natural add-on to the jacket order.

at_sonic.note: Black and grey mesh-back trucker, the same style your team already wears in its headshots, so this keeps the look you have.

st_aquacooler12.note: Insulated 12-can cooler bag for shift lunches. A practical safety-milestone or recognition gift that people actually use every day.

c3_88181.note: Origin performance piqué: lightweight and moisture-wicking for people who spend half the day on a warm plant floor and half in meetings. Our preferred value polo.

c3_88181#w.note: Women's Origin polo in matching black, with sleeved cuts on both so the whole team looks alike.

cbc_advantage_polo.note: Premium recycled cotton-blend polo for leadership, sales and customer visits: the polo you want on when Honda or a government partner tours the plant.

flux.note: Flux quarter-zip sweatshirt: the budget version of the quarter-zip look, for office and admin staff who want a layer without the premium price.
